subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should the first implementation bound the profile summary, membership summary, deletion inventory, and indexed catalog paths while separately tracking the GitHub display-manifest redesign, or must all four paths be completed together?
rationale: The performance defect is source-proven, but the display manifest has a distinct data source and choosing staged delivery versus a comprehensive completion gate requires maintainer scope intent.

options.title: Stage the bounded paths
options.body: Land the three clear bounded-query changes first and preserve a narrowly linked follow-up for the GitHub display-manifest redesign.

options.title: Require comprehensive completion
options.body: Keep one implementation gate until every listed path, including the display manifest, is bounded, redesigned, or intentionally documented.

recommendation.title: Stage the bounded paths
recommendation.body: Land the three clear bounded-query changes first and preserve a narrowly linked follow-up for the GitHub display-manifest redesign.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent implementation history across the publisher profile and catalog surface and supplied the detailed audit boundary.
